name: Live Dashlets
description: KPI, goal, Next Actions and What happened dashlets for EspoCRM: a one-click gallery of ready-made indicators with live previews, trend curves, click-through to the records behind each figure, and one style for every dashlet. Every figure respects the viewer's access rights. Installs a dashboard template that can be deployed to everyone in one click.
author: Alexis SANTIN
